title: Strongly Balanced Almost-Uniform Vector Permutations
exact_target: Does every finite set of $m$-dimensional vectors of Euclidean norm at most $1$, whose vector sum has norm at most $1$, admit a permutation whose every prefix sum has norm at most $\sqrt{2.7m}$ and whose block sums are uniformly bounded by an absolute constant?
